# Income maintenance period

This waiting period may apply if you or your partner have stopped work and got leave or redundancy payments.

Select your payment or service to find out how this impacts you:

### Raising kids

- [Parenting Payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/income-maintenance-period?context=22196)

### Living arrangements

- [Farm Household Allowance](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/income-maintenance-period?context=22161)

### Work

- [JobSeeker Payment](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/income-maintenance-period?context=51411)
- [Youth Allowance for job seekers](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/income-maintenance-period?context=43921)

### Education

- [Austudy](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/income-maintenance-period?context=22441)
- [Youth Allowance for students and Australian Apprentices](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/income-maintenance-period?context=43916)

### Health and disability

- [Disability Support Pension](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/income-maintenance-period?context=22276)
